title: Change Data Capture
description: Streams every insert, update, and delete from the source database's log in real time, so the migration sees changes as they happen. CDC means the migration window can stay open indefinitely - the target just keeps catching up.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Dual-Write
description: Writes to both old and new systems during migration, so either can serve while the cutover approaches. Dual-write de-risks the transition: the old system remains a live fallback until the new one proves itself.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Verification Checksums
description: Compares checksums of source and target - per table, per partition, per row sample - proving the migration moved everything faithfully. Checksums are the evidence that zero-loss actually happened.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Cutover Planning
description: Plans the final switch - sequence, timing, rollback triggers, communication - in a runbook rehearsed beforehand. Good cutover plans make the scariest minute of the migration boring.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Rollback
description: Keeps the old system ready to take traffic back instantly if the new system misbehaves, with the rollback path tested before cutover. Rollback readiness is what lets teams migrate boldly.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Backfill
description: Copies historical data in the background while CDC handles new changes, prioritizing tables by dependency order. Backfill plus CDC is the standard pattern for migrating live databases.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Schema Migration
description: Transforms schemas during the move - renamed columns, split tables, new types - with the mapping versioned and tested. Schema migration is where data moves and improves at the same time.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Data Validation
description: Validates migrated data against business rules - counts, sums, referential integrity - before declaring success. Validation catches the subtle transform bugs checksums miss.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Downtime Budgets
description: Sets the maximum acceptable downtime for the cutover and engineers the migration to fit inside it - often zero. Budgets force the hard choices early: online versus offline, big-bang versus trickle.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Parallel Runs
description: Runs old and new systems side by side on live traffic, comparing outputs before the new system takes over. Parallel runs prove the new system correct under real load, not just in tests.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Idempotent Writes
description: Makes every migration write idempotent so retries and replays never duplicate data. Idempotence turns 'at-least-once' delivery into 'exactly-once' effect, which is what zero-loss requires.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Conflict Resolution
description: Resolves write conflicts during dual-write with declared rules - last-writer-wins, merge functions, manual queues. Declared resolution beats ad-hoc fixes when conflicts inevitably occur.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Progress Tracking
description: Tracks migration progress - tables done, rows per second, ETA - on a live dashboard the whole team watches. Visibility keeps long migrations on track and stakeholders calm.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Post-Migration Audit
description: Audits the completed migration - row counts, checksums, application behavior - and signs off formally. The audit is the ceremony that declares zero-loss achieved, with evidence.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Rehearsal Migrations
description: Runs the full migration against a production copy first, timing every phase and finding the surprises early. Rehearsals turn the real migration into a repeat performance.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
